snippet.title: Shantae Advance: Risky Revolution Deluxe Edition Costume Trailer
snippet.description: Shantae Advance: Risky Revolution arrives digitally on Switch, PS4, PS5, Xbox, and Steam on August 19 in both a Standard Edition and a Deluxe Edition! The Deluxe Edition includes three exclusive extra costumes for Shantae - Relic Hunter Costume, High Voltage Costume, and Sizzle Armor Costume - that change her appearance and power up her abilities! Get Ret-2-Go for this long-lost Shantae adventure!! Get more info at https://wayforward.com/news/announcing-the-shantae-advance-risky-revolution-deluxe-edition.
